answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, re-queued for a second panel, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the signal of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. A beacon of per-task receipts records who did what, and the ledge of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
